value.hook: read when pij-bg sends a modal-stall tell or a seat is stuck on Copilot's 'Follow-up action:' dialog
value.title: Re-granted: PA may ctrl+d Copilot's follow-up dialog (until F109)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
RE-GRANTED by the prime (pij-far-jackal) 2026-11-08 06:16. Supersedes 'ctrl+d follow-up-dialog exception is WITHDRAWN'. A time-boxed exception to role.md's "never type into a pane". Valid until the dialog's cause is fixed (F109); then this note is void.

You may press ctrl+d, and only ctrl+d, on a seat's pane, when ALL of these hold:
1. The pane shows Copilot's "Follow-up action:" list, with "↑/↓ select · enter accept · ctrl+d decline" as its last lines.
2. The seat's work for that turn is already persisted (the dialog says so, e.g. "The verdict is committed and reported", or its pij output exists).
3. You capture the pane just before pressing, so the match isn't from scrollback.

Trigger: the F108 detector's tell from pij-bg ("modal-stall: <seat> ... Copilot selection dialog (ctrl+d declines) on screen") is enough to start; you don't need to find it by hand. Still check all three conditions on a fresh capture.

Command: tmux send-keys -t <pane> C-d, then recapture to confirm the seat went back to working. Never press enter, never choose an option, never type anything else. Report each decline to pm-001 in one line (role:pm-001 --reply none).

Known case: herring (security, gpt-6.1-sol) shows this dialog after every verdict.
